sentences.en: BREDA: Hello, Wayside Camera Club, Breda speaking
sentences.zh: BREDA: 你好，这里是路边摄影俱乐部，我是布雷达。

sentences.en: DAN: Oh, hello, um, my name's Dan and I'd like to join your club
sentences.zh: DAN: 哦，你好，呃，我叫丹，我想加入你们的俱乐部。

sentences.en: BREDA: That's great, Dan
sentences.zh: BREDA: 太好了，丹。

sentences.en: We have an application form - would you like to complete it over the phone, then you can ask any questions you might have?
sentences.zh: 我们有一份申请表——你愿意在电话里填写吗？这样你还可以随时提出任何问题。

sentences.en: DAN
sentences.zh: DAN。

sentences.en: Oh, yes, thanks
sentences.zh: 哦，好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: BREDA: OK, so what's your family name?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 好的，那么你的姓氏是什么？

sentences.en: DAN: It's Green - Dan Green
sentences.zh: DAN: 是格林——丹·格林。

sentences.en: BREDA: So - can I take your email address?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 那么——我可以记下你的电子邮箱地址吗？

sentences.en: DAN: Yes, it's dan1068@market.com
sentences.zh: DAN: 可以，是 dan1068@market.com。

sentences.en: BREDA: Thanks
sentences.zh: BREDA: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And what about your home address?
sentences.zh: 你的家庭住址呢？

sentences.en: DAN: Well, I'm about ten miles away from your club in Peacetown
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯，我住得离你们俱乐部大约十英里，在和平镇。

sentences.en: I live in a house there
sentences.zh: 我住在那儿的一栋房子里。

sentences.en: BREDA: OK, so what's the house number and street?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 好的，那么门牌号和街道名称是什么？

sentences.en: DAN: It's 52 Marrowfield Street
sentences.zh: DAN: 是马罗菲尔德街52号。

sentences.en: BREDA: Is that M-A double R-O-W-F-I-E-L-D?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 拼写是 M-A 双 R-O-W-F-I-E-L-D 吗？

sentences.en: DAN: That's right
sentences.zh: DAN: 没错。

sentences.en: BREDA: and that's Peacetown, you said?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 你刚才说的是和平镇，对吗？

sentences.en: DAN: Uhuh
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: BREDA: So how did you hear about our club?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 那么你是怎么知道我们俱乐部的？

sentences.en: Did you look on the internet?
sentences.zh: 你是在网上查到的吗？

sentences.en: DAN: I usually do that, but this time, well, L was talking to a relative the other day and he suggested it
sentences.zh: DAN: 我通常都是这么做的，但这次呢，嗯，前几天我和一位亲戚聊天，他向我推荐了你们俱乐部。

sentences.en: BREDA: Oh, is he a member too?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 哦，他也是会员吗？

sentences.en: DAN: He belongs to another club - but he'd heard good things about yours
sentences.zh: DAN: 他属于另一个俱乐部——但他听到了不少关于你们俱乐部的好评。

sentences.en: BREDA: OK
sentences.zh: BREDA: 好的。

sentences.en: So what do you hope to get from joining?
sentences.zh: 那么，你希望从加入俱乐部中获得些什么呢？

sentences.en: DAN: Well, one thing that really interests me is the competitions that you have. enjoy entering those
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯，特别吸引我的一点是你们举办的各类摄影比赛，我很喜欢参加这些比赛。

sentences.en: BREDA: Right
sentences.zh: BREDA: 明白了。

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: DAN: Well, I also like to socialise with other photographers
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯，我也很喜欢与其他摄影师交流社交。

sentences.en: BREDA: That's great
sentences.zh: BREDA: 这太好了。

sentences.en: So what type of membership would you like?
sentences.zh: 那么你想选择哪种会员类型呢？

sentences.en: DAN: What are the options?
sentences.zh: DAN: 有哪些选项？

sentences.en: BREDA: It's £30 a year for full membership or £20 a year if you're an associate
sentences.zh: BREDA: 全额会员年费为30英镑，附属会员年费为20英镑。

sentences.en: DAN: I think 'Il go for the full membership, then
sentences.zh: DAN: 我想选择全额会员。

sentences.en: BREDA: a That's a good idea because you can't vote in meetings with an associate membership
sentences.zh: BREDA: 这是个好主意，因为附属会员在会议上没有投票权。

sentences.en: BREDA: If l could just find out a bit more about you
sentences.zh: BREDA: 如果我能再稍微多了解你一些的话……

sentences.en: DAN: OK
sentences.zh: DAN: 好的。

sentences.en: BREDA: So you said you wanted to compete - - have you ever won any photography competitions?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 你刚才提到你想参加比赛——你曾经赢得过任何摄影比赛吗？

sentences.en: DAN: Not yet, but I have entered three in the past
sentences.zh: DAN: 还没有，但我过去参加过三次。

sentences.en: BREDA: Oh, that's interesting
sentences.zh: BREDA: 哦，这很有趣。

sentences.en: So why don't you tell me something about those?
sentences.zh: 那么，你来给我们讲讲那几次参赛经历吧？

sentences.en: Let's start with the first one
sentences.zh: 我们先从第一次开始。

sentences.en: DAN: Well, the theme was entitled 'Domestic Life'
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯，那次比赛的主题叫作‘家庭生活’。

sentences.en: BREDA: I see - so it had to be something related to the home?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 明白了——所以作品必须与家庭相关？

sentences.en: DAN: Yeah
sentences.zh: DAN: 是的。

sentences.en: I chose to take a photo of a family sitting round the dinner table having a meal, and, um, I didn't win, but I did get some feedback
sentences.zh: 我选择拍摄了一张全家围坐在餐桌旁用餐的照片，嗯，虽然没获奖，但我确实收到了一些反馈。

sentences.en: BREDA: Oh, what did the judges say?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 哦，评委们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: DAN: That it was too 'busy' as a picture
sentences.zh: DAN: 他们说这张照片作为一幅作品显得太‘杂乱’了。

sentences.en: BREDA: Aha - so it was the composition of the picture that they criticised?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 啊哈——所以他们批评的是照片的构图？

sentences.en: DAN: That's right - and once they'd told me that, I could see my mistake
sentences.zh: DAN: 没错——他们一指出这点，我就意识到自己的错误了。

sentences.en: BREDA: So what was the theme of the second competition?
sentences.zh: BREDA: 那么第二次比赛的主题是什么呢？

sentences.en: DAN: Well, my university was on the coast and that area gets a lot of beautiful sunsets, sO that was the theme
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯，我当时就读的大学位于海边，而那个地区常有非常美丽的日落，所以主题就是‘日落’。

sentences.en: BREDA: Oh, sunsets, that's a great theme
sentences.zh: BREDA: 哦，日落，这是个很棒的主题。

sentences.en: DAN: Yes
sentences.zh: DAN: 是的。

sentences.en: The instructions were to capture the clouds as well - it couldn't just be blue sky and a setting sun
sentences.zh: 比赛要求不仅要拍到日落，还要把云彩也纳入画面——不能只是蓝天加一个正在下落的太阳。

sentences.en: BREDA: Sure, cause they give you all those amazing pinks and purples
sentences.zh: BREDA: 当然，因为云彩会呈现出那些令人惊叹的粉红色和紫色。

sentences.en: DAN: Yeah - and thought I'd done that well, but the feedback was that I should have waited a bit longer to get the shot
sentences.zh: DAN: 没错——我当时以为自己拍得不错，但反馈意见是，我应该再等一会儿才按下快门。

sentences.en: BREDA: I see
sentences.zh: BREDA: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the timing wasn't right
sentences.zh: 所以拍摄时机不太合适。

sentences.en: DAN: Yes - I took it too soon, basically
sentences.zh: DAN: 对——基本上是我拍得太早了。

sentences.en: And then the third competition I entered was called 'Animal Magic'
sentences.zh: 然后我参加的第三次比赛名叫‘动物奇观’。

sentences.en: BREDA: Well, that's a difficult subject!
sentences.zh: BREDA: 哇，这个题材可真难！

sentences.en: DAN: know!
sentences.zh: DAN: 我知道！

sentences.en: I had to take hundreds of shots
sentences.zh: 我不得不拍了数百张照片。

sentences.en: BREDA: I'm sure - because animals move all the time
sentences.zh: BREDA: 我相信——因为动物总是在不停移动。

sentences.en: DAN: That's what we had to show - there had to be some movement in the scene
sentences.zh: DAN: 这正是我们要展现的——画面中必须体现出某种动态感。

sentences.en: I a got a great shot of a fox in the end, but I took it at night and, well, I suspected that it was a bit dark, which is what I was told
sentences.zh: 最后我拍到了一张很棒的狐狸照片，但那是夜间拍摄的，嗯，我当时就怀疑照片有点太暗了，结果反馈意见也正是如此。

sentences.en: BREDA: Well Dan - you seem to be really keen and we'd be delighted to have you in our club
sentences.zh: BREDA: 好吧，丹——看来你确实非常热衷摄影，我们非常欢迎你加入我们的俱乐部。

sentences.en: I'm sure we can help with all those areas that you've outlined
sentences.zh: 我相信，我们一定能帮你改进你刚才提到的那些方面。

sentences.en: DAN: Thanks, that's great
sentences.zh: DAN: 谢谢，太好了。
